title: The INSANE Engineering of Minecrafts Largest Shulkerfarm
description:
It's finally done! Wavetech's ultimate shulker farm offers a universally compact portal based shulker farm module with the ability to expand the rates of a shulker farm indefinitely.

Intro by The Dark Flame Master, check out his music on Looperman:
https://www.looperman.com/users/tracks/1801113

World Download:
https://www.mediafire.com/file/rb9msbzuo23r90h/Ultimate_Shulker_Farm.zip/file

The Introduction combines Seus PTGI HRR 2.1 developed by Sonic Ether:
https://www.sonicether.com/seus/
With a high resonlution texture pack, Stratum, developed by Continuum Graphics:
https://continuum.graphics/
